research.facts:
Pete Crow-Armstrong — 40 HR, 7 From 40-40
**Sources:** si.com, yahoo sports, espn.com, mlb.com, gokhshtein.com
**Verified Facts (HIGH confidence):**
- PCA hit his 40th HR on Sept. 6, 2026 vs Miami Marlins (5th inning, pulled a sweeper off Tyler Phillips down right-field line)
- Cubs lost 10-3 to Marlins in that game
- PCA now has 40 HR, 33 SB
- Needs 7 more stolen bases to reach 40-40
- ~21 games remaining in season
- The 40-40 club has 6 members: Jose Canseco (1988), Barry Bonds (1996), Alex Rodriguez (1998), Alfonso Soriano (2006), Ronald Acuña Jr. (2023), Shohei Ohtani (2023)
- PCA would be 7th member
- First Cubs player in MLB history with 40 HR and 30+ SB in a season
- 4th player age 24 or younger to accomplish 40 HR + 30 SB (joining Acuña, A-Rod, Canseco)
- Cubs in NL WC1 position
